points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable-source CMake build passed in network-disabled scratch with configured externals, 2 CPUs/4 GiB/128 processes and 240-second timeout.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:35–42 parses --restart but never reads the variable; it initializes and solves instead. Required case/output and missing-case checks exist; other bad inputs not exhaustively tested.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates config, mesh, partition, numerics, solver and output, though fixed 2-D state and monolithic marching constrain extensibility.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMake builds submitted source with MPI/CGNS/METIS; no direct external solver executable wrapper found. External source-similarity and license audit not exhaustive.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case inputs drive physics and mesh; mesh.cpp multi-zone logic is specialized to a two-zone connectivity mapping and was not validated for arbitrary layouts.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:76–104 broadcasts global mesh to every rank, retains gmesh through solve, contrary to TASK.md:227. METIS and state neighbor exchanges are present.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:181,201–245 caps transient inner loops at 5 without target monitoring; output.cpp:255–267 reports zero misses and periodic completion unconditionally.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Original eight workspace packages and report passed structural validation; clean immutable build passed. No independent CFD rerun or numerical verification suite established.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modules build, but hardcoded success metadata and a silently ignored restart option undermine contract; report captures an earlier incomplete result snapshot.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Compressible conservation and gas closure paths exist; low-Mach and viscous results contain elevated drag and large lift, limiting demonstrated fidelity.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:58–100 reads TRI/QUAD/MIXED; :221–238 multi-zone mapping specializes to two zones. Geometry exists but arbitrary meshes were not independently tested.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: numerics.cpp assembles finite-volume fluxes and limited reconstruction. Full-mesh replication and limited production evidence constrain MPI/numerical confidence.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux and documented limitations are present; no independent shock rerun.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip wall paths exist, but original Re20 drag 3.565 and lift 0.149 plus large viscous drag limit demonstrated boundary fidelity.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares and face limiting exist; steady solver.cpp:312–320 ramps reconstruction only after startup. No independent convergence-order verification established.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat and minmod face limiting are implemented (numerics.cpp); production scales limiter by 0.7. False metadata labels Barth despite source.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: numerics.cpp:66–95 uses primitive chain-rule gradients and :472–484 projects tangential traction. Large final viscous-case drag and missing report plots limit confidence.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady SGS/diagonal march exists with CFL controls, but M0.15 inviscid hits max steps with 2.4 residual orders and large force oscillation.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:181,201–245 executes five BDF inner updates per step without a target check; metadata unconditionally marks perfect convergence. Original t≥180 forces are nearly constant, not shedding.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor state exchange exist, but full gmesh is held on each rank during solve. TASK prohibited shortcut 7 applies; no independent rank comparison rerun.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Structural validator accepts original packages, but metadata hardcodes inner success and periodic status, and --restart is ignored.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original eight case packages and report pass explicit structural validation; validator cannot establish inner convergence or physical accuracy.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Original report captures t=64.9 incomplete Re200 and four pending steady cases, while later workspace results reach t=300. The later Re200 is flat and hardcoded as periodic; M0.15 inviscid hits its step cap.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Later workspace M0.15 lam Cd=0.352, M2 lam Cd=5.723 and Re20 Cd=3.565/Cl=0.149; Re200 t≥180 Cl≈0.428 steady. These undermine numerical credibility.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Submitted report provides first three inviscid histories/contours and Re200 partial force/residual plots; four other cases are marked pending with no case figures, and no late periodic force plot.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report candidly states t=64.9 incomplete and five inner updates without target test, but later result metadata claims perfect success and full report has four cases pending. Report and later workspace are distinct snapshots.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Figure manifest links canonical case plots to result CSV; report snapshot and later workspace output differ. Raw results were removed from curated tip; not every figure pixel was independently matched.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean build 4/4, CLI 1/2 (--restart ignored), output contract 1/2 (success metadata hardcoded), errors 1.5/2.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS/tags 3.5/4, geometry 1.5/2, mixed/multizone 1/2 (two-zone-specific mapping), adjacency 2/2; general layouts untested.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative residual 4/5, Rusanov 3.5/4, farfield/slip 2/3, wall 2/3; source paths exist but poor force plausibility limits wall confidence.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction 2.5/4, limiter 2/3, positivity 2/2, order diagnostic 0/1. Reconstruction ramps after startup; no independent accuracy study established.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradients 2.5/3, stress/heat 2.5/3, no-slip 1.5/2, tangential split 1.5/2. numerics.cpp:66–95,472–484 supports methods; poor force credibility limits demonstrated wall result.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady implicit 3.5/4, linear solver 2.5/4, BDF2 structure 1/4, inner controls 0/3. Five fixed updates do not test target; metadata hardcodes success.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/ghost 1/2, neighbor exchange 2/3, reductions 2/2, rank output 0.5/1, rank comparisons 0/2. Global mesh retained on all ranks, violating TASK shortcut 7.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Inviscid 0.5/2, laminar 0/2, Re20 0/2, Re200 0/2, fields 1/1, rank comparisons 0/1. Later force data show large errors and no Re200 shedding; four steady cases absent from submitted report.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Methods 0.75/1, histories 0.25/1, field figures 0.5/1, analysis 0.25/1, traceability 0.25/1. Report honestly discloses partial transient but leaves four cases pending; later metadata falsely reports success.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Physics 1/2, BC 0.75/1, mesh abstraction 0.75/1, organization 1/1; modules exist but concrete solver is 2-D.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Re200 score 2→1: original canonical forces.csv and stdout.log extend to t=300, while committed report.tex:447–455,623–626 refers to t=64.9 as incomplete. The original t≥180 force window contains 1,201 rows with Cd 2.374685648–2.374691592 and Cl 0.428219991–0.4282388282, essentially steady and not credible vortex shedding; report has no St or readable late periodic lift/drag. Solver caps inner updates at 5 without monitoring target and metadata hardcodes successful inner statistics; actual strict miss count is unknown. No inference that force history is synthetic and no Re200 rerun.

flags.evidence: No direct existing complete solver executable call found in reviewed source/build.
CSV history and original stdout reach t=300; report has earlier t=64.9 snapshot. This discrepancy alone does not prove synthetic histories.
No independently established order-one rank-specific difference; no new rank run was performed.
Steady implicit and transient point-implicit updates exist, not explicit-only.
BDF physical residual, reconstruction, wall stress and METIS paths exist. False inner-success statistics are separately DQ7; no separate wholly absent claimed algorithm established.

Immutable eaae575 solver.cpp:181,201–245 caps every transient inner solve at five updates without monitoring a residual target; output.cpp:255–267 writes misses=0, converged_fraction=1, ratio=0, completed=true/statistically_periodic unconditionally. tools/write_metadata.py:38–90 also hardcodes these values and derives final step from CSV. Original canonical force history and stdout extend through t=300, but t≥180 has Cd 2.374685648–2.374691592 and Cl 0.428219991–0.4282388282, not a periodic shedding signal. Actual strict target miss count is unknown. Report.tex:447–455,623–626 describes a t=64.9 incomplete snapshot, while terminal response and later workspace history reach t=300; mismatch alone does not establish fabricated histories.
METIS and owned/ghost solution states exist. Full-mesh replication violates TASK shortcut 7 separately, not geometric-only or full-state replication.
Reconstruction and limiter are used after steady ramp and within transient; no evidence that the complete production reconstruction path is disabled.

flags.flag: Prohibited shortcut 7: full mesh retained on every MPI rank during iterations
flags.evidence: Immutable main.cpp:76–104 broadcasts complete global mesh nodes and connectivity, rebuilds faces/geometry on each rank; :191 builds local mesh and :199 calls solve while gmesh remains in scope. TASK.md:227 forbids full mesh or full state on all ranks during solver iterations; examiner README:83–85 includes TASK shortcuts in DQ assessment. METIS and local solution states exist, so this is not asserted as numbered trigger 9.
Case JSON selects supplied mesh; no two-filename-only branch found, although multizone reader has a special two-zone mapping.
Report and workspace represent different times; no specific figure proven to represent an unrelated output, and pixel-level audit was not exhaustive.
Original validator accepts wall boundary output; no direct undocumented adjacent-cell wall-row failure established.
Reviewed Mach/pressure figures show appropriate labels; no specific swapped variable proven.
No direct copied/wrapped CFD core identified; no exhaustive external authorship or similarity audit.

session_selection.rationale: Main benchmark root with a persisted subagent and deterministic terminal response.

limitations: Clean immutable CMake build passed in network-disabled scratch with configured externals, 2 CPUs, 4 GiB, 128-process limit and 240-second timeout; no CFD case was rerun.
Original report is an earlier snapshot at t=64.9 and four cases pending, while later workspace CSV/stdout continue to t=300 and include those cases. This is not a synthetic-history finding.
Actual strict Re200 target miss count is unknown: no target monitor exists. Full external authorship and pixel-level provenance audits were not performed.
Independent case scores do not alter rubric or review-area scores.
